arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-final-audit.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
printf 'REA_HOST_USER='; id -un
printf 'REA_HOST_OS='; uname -s
printf 'REA_HOST_PYTHON='; python3 --version
if command -v codex >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'REA_HOST_CODEX_BIN_PRESENT=YES'; else echo 'REA_HOST_CODEX_BIN_PRESENT=NO'; fi
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
printf 'PROJECT_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = c39ee2add4862e902d6fb9c0ac6bfaa1d867a6ed
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast
from pathlib import Path
files=['codex/smart.py','codex/dual.py','codex/agent_policy.py','codex/tests/test_smart.py','codex/tests/test_dual.py','AGENTS.md','CODEX_COORDINATION.md','README_CODEX.md']
for file in files:
 p=Path(file)
 print('AUDIT_FILE',file,'exists',p.is_file(),'lines',len(p.read_text().splitlines()) if p.is_file() else 0,flush=True)
 if not p.is_file():continue
 s=p.read_text().splitlines()
 for i,line in enumerate(s):
  if any(x in line for x in ('def _private_runs_root(', 'def _private_runs(', 'def _worker(', 'def _codex', 'def run(', 'def execute(', 'def test_cloud_readonly', 'def test_default_readonly', 'def test_explicit_readonly', 'def test_runs_directory_symlink','CODEX_HOME','XDG_STATE_HOME','XDG_RUNTIME_DIR','subprocess.run(','codex exec','Read-only file system','def test_parallel','def test_serial')):
   print('SOURCE_MARKER',file,i+1,line[:180],flush=True)
p=Path('codex/dual.py')
src=p.read_text().splitlines()
for i,line in enumerate(src):
 if line.startswith('def _worker(') or line.startswith('def _private_runs_root('):
  print('SOURCE_DETAIL',p.name,i+1,'\\n'.join(src[i:i+100])[:8500],flush=True)
PY
python3 -m unittest codex.tests.test_smart codex.tests.test_dual -q
echo 'TARGETED_TESTS=PASS'
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo 'REA_PREFLIGHT=PASS'
